token_note: tokens are tiktoken o200k_base counts over the returned passages' content: exact for current OpenAI models, an approximation for other main models
cost_unit_note: cost is per search: a chat re-sends each search's passages on later agent iterations, so the per-chat saving is per-search saving x searches x re-sends while the engine is paid once per search; a positive per-search net is a floor for the per-chat net, a negative one is printed with its break-even re-send count
threshold_note: the D-07 prune (floor 0.1, keep at least 3) was fixed in rerank_engines.prune before this held-out set was frozen and was not tuned after seeing these results (D-18)
